title: Continuous Time-Varying Emotion Control Zero-Shot Text-To-Speech With Emotion Orthogonal LoRA
abstract: High-quality emotional text-to-speech (TTS) often depends on large scale corpora and coarse discrete emotion labels, which limits fine-grained and time-varying control in practice. We address this by integrating continuous Valence, Arousal, and Dominance (VAD) control into a pretrained model via low-rank updates inserted into the backbone transformations. Our Emotion Orthogonal LoRA (EO-LoRA) uses three separate low-rank branches aligned to valence, arousal, and dominance, and an orthogonality regularizer encourages the branches to capture distinct effects. We further introduce Flow-DGPO, a reinforcement learning alignment stage for flow matching TTS that improves emotion controllability while preserving intelligibility and speaker similarity. Experiments show that our method improves continuous and time-varying emotion control while maintaining synthesis quality with limited training data.
relevance_note: Emotion-orthogonal LoRA for continuous time-varying VAD emotion control in zero-shot TTS; TTS control method.
